11.note: N4.1 re-measure with the belt art in (sky dome, canvas albedo + normal + roughness maps, instanced props, weather particles), Medium, 1920x1080 at pixel ratio 1, GPU forced to finish every frame, camera turning a full circle, two runs each. District 20 (TIDE at midnight, heaviest rain, 5200-particle budget): mean 3.7 / 3.7 ms, p95 9.6 / 7.1 ms, 141 draw calls. District 30 (MOSS at midnight, vines and spores): mean 2.9 / 6.3 ms, p95 3.5 / 11.5 ms, 122 calls, 215k triangles. District 100 (COBALT, the biggest city, on the fallback art with the new sky): mean 4.7 / 6.5 ms, p95 7.9 / 10.4 ms, 132 calls, 273k triangles. All under the 16.7 ms budget and the 150-call cap. Timings in a hidden pane vary by about a third between runs. Build 26 (N8.4, district 100 before the art): mean 5.3-8.4 ms, p95 10.7-12.2 ms. Weaker laptops and phones: not measured.
